title: DECISION: GroupFilter rejects all-negation filter at construction
description: GroupFilter::new() returns Err(AllNegation) when all patterns are negated or the pattern list is empty. A filter where every entry is a negation can never accept any group name — it would silently drop all articles. Catching this at construction time (config load) rather than at runtime means operators get an immediate startup error instead of a silent black-hole that discards all traffic.
